owner.technicalStorageProvider: yudao-module-infra public FileStorageReceiptApi approved by ADR-0035

plt_file_artifact.purpose: tenant-aware stable business identity independent from storage object and content versions
plt_file_artifact.identityPolicy: artifact id never changes on new content and is never an infra file id, path or URL
plt_file_artifact.deletionPolicy: logical delete only for a never-referenced draft; id and version history are never reused

plt_file_version.purpose: immutable content version and stable technical storage receipt
plt_file_version.immutability: no application update or delete entry for content, hash, size, media type, storage receipt or version number
plt_file_version.availabilityVersionPolicy: increment on AVAILABLE, UNAVAILABLE or INVALIDATED transition and recovery; immutable content fields never change
plt_file_version.storageBoundary: infra_file_id is the only persisted technical locator; it is not a PLT business identity and no database foreign key points to INFRA

plt_file_reference.purpose: stable business object purpose slot fixed to one artifact and immutable version at a time
plt_file_reference.replacementPolicy: an ACTIVE business-mutable reference may CAS to a new version of the same artifact; a DETACHED stable slot may rebind and return ACTIVE only after fresh provider authorization and If-Match; business approvals retain frozen artifactId plus versionNo

plt_file_upload_session.purpose: one authorized short-lived upload intent and its completion/compensation facts
plt_file_upload_session.successPolicy: COMPLETED requires PASSED when security scanning is enabled, otherwise SKIPPED; both require registered INFRA receipt, committed FileVersion and committed FileReference create/CAS
plt_file_upload_session.uploadPolicy: init returns no storage credential; session id is the trusted storageOperationId and multipart content is bounded to 50MB before INFRA store

plt_file_access_grant.purpose: short-lived least-privilege download or preview authorization
plt_file_access_grant.secretPolicy: store irreversible token digest only; never persist token plaintext or short-lived URL

plt_file_archive_record.purpose: append-only archive fact for an exact artifact version and business decision
plt_file_archive_record.immutability: append-only; no update or delete application entry

stateAxes.businessApproval: owned only by the referencing business context and never inferred from file states

transactions.initUpload: TRUSTED_TENANT_AND_ACTOR; FUNCTION_PERMISSION; BUSINESS_PROVIDER_INSPECT; FILE_POLICY; IDEMPOTENCY_CLAIM; CREATE_UPLOAD_SESSION_WITH_TRUSTED_STORAGE_OPERATION_ID; AUDIT
transactions.completeUpload: LOCK_SESSION; IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_OR_CONFLICT; MULTIPART_LIMIT_AND_BOUNDED_READ; SERVER_SIZE_HASH_MIME_AND_SCAN; INFRA_RECEIPT_STORE; LOCK_ARTIFACT; ALLOCATE_VERSION; CREATE_IMMUTABLE_FILE_VERSION; CREATE_OR_CAS_REFERENCE; COMPLETE_SESSION; WRITE_FILE_OUTBOX; IDEMPOTENCY_SUCCESS; AUDIT
transactions.access: FUNCTION_PERMISSION; BUSINESS_PROVIDER_REVALIDATE; FILE_VERSION_AVAILABLE; CREATE_SHORT_LIVED_GRANT; PRESIGN_INFRA_GET; AUDIT

fileFactVersionSources.artifactVersion: plt_file_artifact.version; changes on artifact lifecycle mutation
fileFactVersionSources.referenceVersion: plt_file_reference.version; changes on bound version, reference status or persisted scope fact mutation
fileFactVersionSources.availabilityVersion: plt_file_version.availability_version; changes on exact version availability, invalidation or recovery

fileArtifactApi.referenceSelection: non-empty referenceKey is mandatory and combines with trusted tenantId, ownerContext, objectType, objectId and purposeCode to select exactly one stable reference slot; lock revalidates its artifactId, versionNo, status and referenceVersion
fileArtifactApi.conflictPolicy: scope, artifact lifecycle, exact version availability, selected reference target/status or any expected version change fails closed with VERSION_CONFLICT and no consumer success side effect
fileArtifactApi.unknownPolicy: empty referenceKey, missing, cross-tenant, unreferenced, invalidated, unavailable, unauthorized or version-changed facts fail closed and never widen the query

businessObjectPolicyProvider.selectionPolicy: exactly one provider must support a key; zero, multiple, exception or unknown action fail closed
businessObjectPolicyProvider.solFirstConsumer: SOL/CONSTRUCTION_PLAN_CHANGE/CUSTOMER_DELAY_EVIDENCE; authorizes file actions only and never writes or returns PRE-01 approval status

securityScanProvider.disabledPolicy: disabled scanning invokes no provider and persists SKIPPED with null provider code/version
securityScanProvider.failurePolicy: when scanning is enabled, missing or multiple providers, REJECTED, ERROR, exception or unknown result prevents FileVersion and FileReference success and never degrades to SKIPPED

store.lookup: derive one reserved cross-config path from storageOperationId; search all configs; zero creates on frozen current master, one returns frozen config record, multiple fail closed to reconciliation

delete.response: zero is already complete, one deletes by frozen configId plus path, multiple fail closed to reconciliation

infraFileStorageReceiptApi.uploadBoundary: reuse existing Yudao/Spring MultipartFile and MaxUploadSizeExceededException; forward-adjust NPDMS application max-file-size from 16MB to 50MB and max-request-size for form overhead without framework change; then apply 50MB+1 bounded read before full allocation and INFRA store; no storage object readback
infraFileStorageReceiptApi.compatibility: retain all existing FileApi and FileClient methods and observable behavior; new DTOs contain no tenant, business object, PLT identity or permission fields

permissions.frontendBackendTruth: same permission codes; server revalidates trusted tenant, function, business provider, scopeVersion, file status and CAS

configuration.storagePolicy: private bucket, server encryption and TLS; deployment-specific config is not a Feature Ready blocker
configuration.scanPolicy: a configured FileSecurityScanProvider is mandatory for successful completion; provider product and environment instance are selected in Technical Plan/Deployment without changing this contract

platformFacts.outboxPolicy: business fact and event are written in the same PLT transaction; immutable payload excludes content, short-lived URL, token and storage path; retry uses stable eventId and must not duplicate business facts; failed business transaction emits no success event
